title: Cloud Storage Privacy Risk Calculator - Assess Your Data Security
metaDescription: Calculate your cloud storage privacy risk score. Evaluate provider security, encryption, and data protection to keep your files safe from breaches.
description: Assess your cloud storage privacy risks with our comprehensive calculator. Evaluate your provider's security practices, encryption methods, and data protection features to understand how well your files are protected from unauthorized access.

formula: const providerScores = { 'google-drive': 60, 'dropbox': 55, 'onedrive': 65, 'icloud': 70, 'proton-drive': 15, 'tresorit': 10, 'pcloud-crypto': 20, 'other': 80 }; const dataTypeScores = { 'personal': 10, 'business': 25, 'financial': 40, 'medical': 45, 'legal': 35, 'creative': 20 }; const encryptionReduction = { 'none': 0, 'manual': -25, 'zero-knowledge': -30, 'third-party': -20 }; const sharingScores = { 'never': 0, 'rare': 5, 'occasional': 10, 'frequent': 20, 'daily': 30 }; let baseScore = providerScores[provider] || 80; baseScore += dataTypeScores[dataTypes] || 10; baseScore += encryptionReduction[encryptionUsed] || 0; baseScore += sharingScores[sharingFrequency] || 10; if (!twoFactor) baseScore += 15; if (dataAmount > 100) baseScore += 5; if (dataAmount > 500) baseScore += 10; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, baseScore)); let riskLevel, recommendation; if (riskScore <= 25) { riskLevel = 'Low Risk'; recommendation = 'Great privacy practices! Consider using a privacy-focused browser for additional web privacy.'; } else if (riskScore <= 50) { riskLevel = 'Moderate Risk'; recommendation = 'Enable 2FA and consider encrypted providers like Proton Drive or Tresorit.'; } else if (riskScore <= 75) { riskLevel = 'High Risk'; recommendation = 'Switch to zero-knowledge providers and encrypt sensitive files before upload.'; } else { riskLevel = 'Critical Risk'; recommendation = 'Immediately migrate to encrypted storage like Tresorit and enable all security features.'; } return { riskScore, riskLevel, recommendation };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your cloud storage privacy risk based on provider security practices, data sensitivity, encryption usage, account security, and sharing habits. Scores range from 0-100, with lower scores indicating better privacy protection.
tips: Use zero-knowledge encrypted providers like Proton Drive or Tresorit for sensitive data
Always enable two-factor authentication on your cloud storage accounts
Encrypt sensitive files locally before uploading to any cloud service
Regularly review and revoke sharing permissions for old files and folders
Use a privacy-focused browser when accessing cloud storage to prevent tracking
